title: Hands-free driving and connectivity
summary: Reviews discuss hands-free features with one positive comment on low-speed hands-off driving, one negative complaint about unreliable system connection, and two undetermined remarks about speed limits and assist parking.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the hands-off driving function works very well below 60 km/h.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the hands-free system connects unreliably and requires repeated unpairing and pairing before driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined remarks mention that hands-free service only applies under 60 km and that the assist parking option feels intimidating, but the overall sentiment is unclear.

limitations: The topic includes related but not identical subjects, including hands-off driving, hands-free system connectivity, service speed restrictions, and assist parking.
There are few examples, so the feedback does not support broader conclusions beyond the sampled remarks.
Two of the four examples are undetermined, which limits clarity about overall customer sentiment on this topic.
